attributes.name: walking_locomotion
attributes.text: The person walks, moving the whole body to a new place.
attributes.definition: The feet take several alternating steps and the hips travel across the floor.

attributes.name: airborne_phase
attributes.text: Both feet leave the ground at some moment.
attributes.definition: At least once, no foot supports the body, as in a jump or hop.

attributes.name: repeated_in_place_leg_cycles
attributes.text: The legs repeat a cycle while the body stays in one spot.
attributes.definition: The legs lift or bounce repeatedly but the hips do not travel across the floor.

attributes.name: hips_lower_vertically
attributes.text: The hips move down toward the floor in a controlled way.
attributes.definition: The hip joints drop noticeably as both knees bend, with the feet staying in place, and the movement is not a fall.

attributes.name: hips_rise_to_standing
attributes.text: The body rises from low hips to standing.
attributes.definition: The hip joints move upward as the knees straighten, ending in a standing posture.

attributes.name: uncontrolled_fall
attributes.text: The body drops quickly and loses support.
attributes.definition: The hips and torso go down fast and do not stop at seat height; the body ends low on the floor.

attributes.name: weight_shift_between_legs
attributes.text: Body weight shifts from one leg to the other.
attributes.definition: The hips move clearly over one foot and then the other, or from the back leg to the front leg, during the action.

attributes.name: standing_on_one_leg
attributes.text: The body is supported on one leg for part of the action.
attributes.definition: One foot leaves the floor and the other foot alone carries the body for a noticeable time.

attributes.name: unsteady_sway
attributes.text: The body sways or staggers unsteadily.
attributes.definition: The torso and hips wobble sideways or forward and back in an irregular way, and steps may be uneven.

attributes.name: steps_backward
attributes.text: The person takes one or more steps backward.
attributes.definition: A foot moves behind the body and the hips follow, moving the body backward.

attributes.name: whole_body_bounce
attributes.text: The whole body bounces up and down.
attributes.definition: The hips and head rise and fall together in short vertical movements, through knee bending or hopping.

attributes.name: upper_body_only_feet_planted
attributes.text: Only the upper body moves; the feet and hips stay fixed.
attributes.definition: The ankle, knee and hip joints stay in place for the whole action while the arms, head, or torso move.
